name: Bades Bay
hero_subtitle: Picturesque bay facing the historic rock of Badis — open sand and a quieter horizon on the park coast.

overview.title: Bay and historic rock
overview.p1: Bades Bay (Plage de Badis) opens wider than the small town coves, with sand and a backdrop tied to the historic site of Badis on this stretch of Mediterranean coast.
overview.p2: It suits travellers who want more space and a park-coast atmosphere after Quemado and Sfiha. Services are lighter; the landscape does the work.
overview.p3: Plan transport in advance and bring water. A calm day here pairs naturally with Cala Iris or the Torres viewpoints.

food.title: Food near Bades Bay
food.p1: Plan meals in Al Hoceima town or at seasonal beach cafés; pack water for park-coast outings.
food.li1: Grilled fish near the port and corniche.
food.li2: Simple cafés at Quemado and Sfiha in season.
food.li3: Carry water and snacks for Cala Iris, Torres and Bades.
food.li4: Hotel restaurants if you stay on the bay.
food.li5: Confirm opening hours outside peak summer.
food.p2: Cash helps at small beach and village stops.

q1.question: How far from Al Hoceima?
q1.answer: Further west along the park coast — treat it as a day outing, not a quick taxi hop.

q2.question: Swimming?
q2.answer: Yes in suitable conditions; check local advice on currents and access.

q3.question: Historic Badis?
q3.answer: The bay sits in a historically charged coastal setting; ask locally about viewpoints and any access rules.

q4.question: Crowded?
q4.answer: Usually quieter than Quemado in town — peak summer weekends can still draw visitors.

q5.question: Need a 4x4?
q5.answer: A normal car with a careful driver is often enough; confirm road conditions in advance.

page.title: Bades
page.intro: Explore Bades, a captivating destination offering unforgettable landscapes, historical heritage, and rich cultural experiences in Morocco.

content.hero_subtitle: Discover the authentic charm and unique experiences of Bades.
content.sec1_text: Located in one of Morocco's most picturesque regions, Bades offers visitors an immersive journey into rich heritage, stunning architecture, and warm local hospitality.
content.sec2_text: Whether you are exploring historical sites, tasting traditional Moroccan flavors, or discovering surrounding natural landscapes, Bades provides memorable moments for every traveler.
content.sec3_text: To make the most of your visit to Bades, plan your itinerary during optimal seasons, connect with certified local guides, and experience authentic local accommodations.
